issues.description: Method naming mismatch in Exercise 1: the template class defines a stub method named build_grover(...) but the template's run() helper calls self.grover_circuit(...). The solution implementation and expected workflow use the method name grover_circuit(...). This inconsistent identifier will cause the provided run() helper to raise AttributeError for students who implement build_grover as the template suggests and will confuse which method name the tests or autograder expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across template, solution, and helper. Prefer renaming the template stub build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...) (signature and docstring) so students implement grover_circuit and run() exercises the implemented method. Alternatively, change run() to call build_grover and update the solution and tests to match. Update the problem statement and any tests to reference the same method name.
